label_config.identity: (sequence, category_id, str(tracking_id)); retain numeric track_id without editing source
label_config.support: unchanged legacy gaussian_region floor(255*g)>0, sigma=w/6,h/6, bbox truncated
label_config.positive: all valid non-ignore/non-crowd boxes fully inside crop core9, nonempty support after exclusions
label_config.background: exact legacy build_batch full-GT bbox+2 exclusion and core9
label_config.negative_eligibility: all window-valid tracks observed now AND no excluded-object bbox+2 intersects pre-exclusion core9 AND no empty-support positive object now
label_config.missing: unknown; no inferred absence or interpolation
label_config.overlap: separate object supports, allowed to overlap; excluded bbox+2 overrides all supports
label_config.empty_support: omit positive and assignment; disable negatives on that frame; no forced point
label_config.coordinates: original full-frame float bbox; crop origin y,x retained; flattened local raster row-major indices
